title: SCC auto-activation & Security Questionnaire (SQ) mapping to Data Residency SKUs — prototype
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Background: Large enterprise customers repeatedly flag two blockers in sales cycles: (1) lack of a clear, auditable mapping from Security Questionnaire (SQ) answers to contract obligations (SCCs, retention, subprocessors) and (2) opaque pricing/packaging when special residency or SCC activation is required. Legal review and manual addenda creation adds 2–6 weeks to procurement.

Objective: Prototype an automated flow that (A) maps canonical SQ responses to a small, defensible set of contract outcomes (SCC activation, retention cap, subprocessors disclosure), (B) surfaces a clear SKU pricing delta for each outcome so sales can give fast, consistent quotes, and (C) auto-generates the contract addendum and flags engineering provisioning (SLA/region pin, retention policy). The prototype should be lightweight, auditable, and conservative: SCC activation is explicit and reversible until signed.

Scope: This ticket covers the product decision model and prototype UI/workflow for sales/solutions engineers plus the PRD for backend signals. Implementation of persistent contract signing and billing integration will follow in a subsequent ticket. Out-of-scope: full e-signature integration, on-prem package changes, and billing system migration.

Success metrics: reduction in procurement time for residency/SCC deals from avg 21 days to <=7 days; sales confidence score >80% in pilot accounts; three pilot customers onboarded with correct SCC activation and matching invoices.

Trade-offs considered: (1) Strict automation could mis-classify nuanced legal requirements; to mitigate, we design for human-in-the-loop review before final activation. (2) Surface-level pricing SKUs reduce legal negotiation flexibility; therefore pricing SKUs are presented as guidance with an optional manual override requiring Legal sign-off. (3) Storing SQ answers increases PII/data surface; we will redact free-text and retain canonicalized answers only.

Stakeholders: Legal (Sofia Martinez), Sales Eng (Jamal Reed), Solutions Eng (Priya Nair), Billing (Marco Li), Engineering owner (ENG-1842 / Kiran Shah), Console UX (DES-98 collaboration).

acceptance_criteria: Prototype UI flow that captures canonical SQ answers and shows derived contract outcomes (SCC required: yes/no; retention bucket; subprocessors list).
Pricing SKUs presented with delta and rationale in quote UI mockup (standard vs residency vs SCC).
Backend API that persists canonicalized SQ answers, contract flags, and immutable audit trail (redacted free-text).
Human-in-the-loop review step implemented in mock: Legal must approve auto-generated addendum before final activation in pilot accounts.
Three pilot customers complete a full flow from SQ -> quote -> addendum generation without manual doc authoring by Legal.
decisions: Adopt canonical answer set of 12 SQ questions to drive deterministic outcomes for prototype.
Show pricing delta only; final invoice integration deferred to follow-up ticket.
Require Legal approval for first three auto-activated addenda (pilot).
Store canonicalized answers and audit metadata; redact free-text to reduce PII footprint.
